info.title: Sodapop API
info.summary: Authenticated, friend-scoped soda check-in API (v1.11 surface).
info.description: Sodapop exposes an intentionally narrow API. There is no endpoint that lists the whole catalog, all users or all venues. Catalog access is limited to single-drink reads, an authenticated search capped at 10 results, and barcode resolution. Social reads are limited to your own data and accepted friends. All data endpoints require a personal `sd_` bearer token; requests are rate limited per token.

bearerAuth.description: Personal API token created in Settings, or exchanged by the Android app via `/api/v1/auth/mobile-token`. Scopes: read, write, feed.

venue_id.description: Venue the check-in was logged at.

distance_m.description: Distance to the venue, bucketed down to 100 m so responses cannot be used for metre-level triangulation.

rating_shown.description: Averages are shown only after 3 distinct raters.

idempotency_key.description: Replaying the same key returns the original check-in.

user_id.description: Author id. Handles are in `user`; ids are stable for deletion checks.

can_delete.description: True when the viewer authored the comment or is a moderator.

image.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF; 25 MiB total request body.

comments_count.description: Live comments only; deleted comments and deleted authors are excluded.

saved.description: True when the authenticated viewer has bookmarked this check-in.

friend_request_id.description: Present only for an incoming pending friend request.

ListItemInput.description: Supply either drink_id or slug. Re-adding a drink already in the list returns the existing item.

current.description: Always false for bearer-token requests, which have no browser session cookie.

tags.name: public
tags.description: The single published, unauthenticated catalog fact sheet. There is no public collection route.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Token exchange for the web and Android clients.

tags.name: me

tags.description: Friend requests and the accepted friend graph.

get.summary: Discover whether Authelia OIDC is enabled

post.summary: Exchange a browser session for a personal token
post.description: Requires the `sd_session` cookie and the per-session CSRF token. Used by the Flutter Android app after Authelia WebView sign-in.

post.summary: Exchange email/handle and password for a token
post.description: Password sign-in for first-party clients when password login is enabled. Returns a personal `sd_` token shown once. Generic errors avoid account enumeration.

403.description: Password sign-in disabled or email not verified

post.description: Creates an unverified local account and queues a verification email. The first account on a fresh instance is bootstrapped as a verified admin. Rate limited per IP.

201.description: Account created or verification email queued

403.description: Password registration disabled, registration closed, or email not allowed

409.description: Handle or email already in use

post.description: Single-use, 24-hour verification token. Invalid, used and expired tokens share one generic error.
Always returns 202 regardless of whether the address exists, is verified, or is OIDC-only.
Always returns 202 for unknown or passwordless accounts so the endpoint cannot enumerate users.

400.description: Invalid or expired token, or weak password

get.description: Unauthenticated catalog fact sheet for one published, non-merged drink. Unpublished, provisional, merged, discontinued and unknown slugs all return the same 404. There is no collection or list route.

rating.description: Null until at least 3 people have rated the drink.

404.description: Unknown, unpublished or otherwise non-public slug

delete.description: Soft-deletes the account and revokes every browser session, personal API token and inbound webhook token. The body must echo your exact handle. Requires the write scope and a verified email. The last active admin cannot be closed.

409.description: The sole active admin cannot be deleted

get.description: Returns the same JSON document as `GET /export.json`: your profile, check-ins, lists, badges and settings. The response is the raw document, not wrapped in a `data` envelope. Requires the read scope; email verification is not required.

200.description: Account export as a downloadable JSON file

schema.description: The user's own data as a JSON document.

get.summary: Read your profile, preferences, sessions and counts

patch.description: Accepts any subset of the fields. Every supplied value is validated before anything is written. Requires the write scope and a verified email.

403.description: Missing write scope or unverified email

post.description: Stores or refreshes an FCM token for the caller. A token moved from another account is reassigned. Requires the write scope and a verified email.

403.description: Missing write scope or unverified email

delete.description: Deletes one FCM token owned by the caller. Requires the write scope and a verified email.

403.description: Missing write scope or unverified email

404.description: The caller has no such device

delete.description: Deletes all web sessions for the caller. API tokens are unaffected. Requires the write scope and a verified email.

403.description: Missing write scope or unverified email
Missing write scope or unverified email

404.description: Session does not belong to the caller

post.description: Verifies the current password, stores the new one, and revokes every other browser session. Requires the write scope and a verified email.

400.description: Invalid current password, weak new password, or passwordless account

403.description: Missing write scope or unverified email

get.description: Unblock with DELETE /api/v1/users/{handle}/block.
Self-only timeline of the token owner's activity rows, newest first. There is no global or cross-user variant.
Lifetime counters plus the current and longest check-in day streaks. Self only.

get.summary: Your sugar, caffeine and calorie insights
get.description: Derived from your own non-deleted check-ins and the drink nutrition facts per 100 ml. Self only.
Most recent 50 notifications for the token owner. Each row carries a safe relative `href` and, for an incoming pending friend request, a `friend_request_id`. No totals are returned.

post.description: Omit `id` to mark everything read.

get.description: Returns check-ins from you and accepted friends only. There is no global or public feed.

Returns visible check-ins at venues within the requested radius of a caller-supplied point. Only your own, accepted friends' and followed users' visible check-ins are eligible; strangers' private check-ins are never returned. The point is not stored or echoed. Distances are bucketed down to 100 m and pagination uses an opaque cursor.

200.description: Nearby check-ins, nearest first. meta.has_more reports more rows among the fetched candidates; meta.next_before is only set when has_more is true.

post.description: Always returns 202, including for unknown handles, to prevent account enumeration.

404.description: Request missing or not addressed to you

delete.summary: Remove a friend or pending request

post.description: Requires the write scope and a verified email. Ratings are quarter-stars (0.25 steps).

image.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF. Optional; omit to create a text-only check-in.

get.description: Owner, accepted friends (for `friends` check-ins) or anyone (for `public` check-ins). Other users' private rows return 404. Capability flags mirror the web detail page and the token's scopes.

200.description: The check-in with viewer capability flags

get.description: Binary media for a check-in photo, avatar, drink/brand image or active venue photo. Visibility matches the web app: the owner always; anyone for `public` check-ins and catalog media; accepted friends for `friends` check-ins. Missing, deleted and not-visible rows all return 404. There is no media listing endpoint.

404.description: Missing, soft-deleted or not visible to this viewer

get.description: The 480px thumbnail for a media row, falling back to the original for videos that have no thumbnail. Access rules are identical to `/api/v1/media/{id}`; invisible rows return 404.

200.description: The stored thumbnail (or the original when none exists)

404.description: Missing, soft-deleted or not visible to this viewer

get.description: Visible only when the parent check-in is visible to the viewer. An invisible parent returns 404. Returns one page of comments oldest-first. There is no total count; use meta.has_more and meta.next_before to page backwards through older comments.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: ID of the oldest comment already seen; returns strictly older comments.

count.description: Number of comments on this page.

has_more.description: Whether older comments exist beyond this page.

next_before.description: Cursor for the next older page; present only when has_more is true.

post.description: Requires the write scope and a verified email. The parent must be visible to the viewer (404 otherwise). Capped at 1,000 characters and 30 comments per user per hour.

delete.description: Authors may delete their own comment; moderators may delete any. Everyone else receives 404 so the endpoint cannot confirm that a comment exists.

get.description: Handle, display name, bio, visible stats, follow/friend state, earned badges, top styles and visible lists. Missing, blocked and deleted accounts return 404. Unearned badge definitions and unearned progress are never exposed. There is no user directory.
Only your own account or an accepted friend is readable; anything else returns 404.

404.description: Not a friend or unknown user

get.description: Requires at least 2 characters. By default returns at most 10 drink results, with no cursor or total. With type=all the data envelope contains grouped drinks (max 4), brands (max 3) and styles (max 3), capped at 10 rows total. This is the only catalog discovery endpoint and it cannot be paginated.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Set to all to include grouped brands and styles.

200.description: Default: at most 10 drink results. type=all: {drinks,brands,styles} grouped and capped (4/3/3, 10 total). No totals.

get.description: Normalizes to GTIN-14, then checks the local catalog, the Open Food Facts cache, and finally Open Food Facts itself. OFF data is returned as an attributed suggestion, never merged into the catalog automatically.

post.description: Soft-key deduplication means submitting an equivalent soda returns the existing drink with 200 instead of creating a duplicate. Capped at 20/hour/token.

get.description: Reports the outbound webhook configuration and inbound token metadata for your account. Never returns a token or a shared secret.

200.description: Integration state, including the inbound webhook path and active token metadata

get.description: Requires 2+ characters and returns at most 20 results; no directory export.

get.summary: Read one venue and recently seen drinks

post.description: Deduplicated within 150 metres or by identical name+city. Capped at 10/hour/token.

get.summary: List a venue's photos and menus
get.description: Active rows only. The list is bounded by the venue cap; there is no total or pagination count.

post.summary: Upload a venue photo or menu
post.description: Requires the write scope and a verified email. Multipart upload capped at a 25 MiB request body, 6 active rows per uploader per venue and 20 per venue.

409.description: Venue or uploader media cap reached

413.description: Request body exceeds 25 MiB or image exceeds 12 MiB

delete.summary: Remove a venue photo or menu
delete.description: The uploader or a moderator may remove an active row. Everyone else receives 404 so the endpoint cannot confirm that a row exists.

post.summary: Draft a soda from rough notes
post.description: Conversational structured drafting. Returns a draft and a session id for follow-up turns. Requires an enabled AI endpoint.
Turn rough flavour impressions into a concise tasting note. No exclamation marks, no sugar shaming.
Soda Sommelier recommendations from a short history summary. Recommendations never expose another user's private data.

Idempotent. Ends an accepted or pending friendship and hides both users from each other's feeds, notifications, comments, toasts and friend requests. Existing content is preserved. Unknown and self handles return 404.

403.description: Missing write scope or unverified email

delete.description: Removes only the caller's own block. Unknown and self handles return 404.

403.description: Missing write scope or unverified email

get.description: Newest first. Bounded to one drink's gallery; there is no total or pagination count.

post.description: Requires the write scope and a verified email. Multipart image capped at 25 MiB, JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF. New images are not auto-promoted; only admins can set the primary image or delete one.

403.description: Missing write scope or unverified email

post.description: Admin or moderator only. Clears any previous primary image for the same drink.

delete.description: Admin or moderator only. Removes the image row and its media row; the drink itself is kept.

get.summary: List internal notes on a report
get.description: Admin only; non-admins receive 404.

404.description: Report missing or caller is not an admin

post.summary: Add an internal note to a report
post.description: Admin only; non-admins receive 404. Body is 1-2000 characters.

404.description: Report missing or caller is not an admin
Note missing or caller is not an admin

post.description: Append one user message to an owned draft session. History is capped at 20 messages without splitting user/assistant pairs.

404.description: Draft missing or owned by another user

post.description: Ask the model to revise the current draft fields. Owner-only; unknown and foreign drafts both return 404.

404.description: Draft missing or owned by another user

post.description: Create a provisional catalog drink from a ready draft. Idempotent for the same session.

200.description: Provisional drink committed or already committed

404.description: Draft missing or owned by another user

get.description: Admin only; non-admins receive 404. API keys are masked.

post.description: Admin only; non-admins receive 404.

404.description: Endpoint missing or caller is not an admin
Endpoint missing or caller is not an admin

post.description: Admin only; non-admins receive 404.

404.description: Endpoint missing or caller is not an admin

post.description: Admin only; non-admins receive 404.

404.description: Endpoint missing or caller is not an admin

post.description: Requires the write scope and a verified email. Unknown, deleted and blocked targets return 404; a self-follow returns 400. Repeating a successful follow still returns 204.

delete.description: Requires the write scope and a verified email. Unknown, deleted and blocked targets return 404; a self-unfollow returns 400. Removing an absent follow is an idempotent 204.

get.description: The viewer's bookmarked venues only, newest first. Read scope; no totals.
Every list you own, including the system wishlist, with item counts. This is never another user's collection.

Public and friends lists follow the same visibility ladder as check-ins. System lists are owner-only. Missing, invisible and blocked-owner lists return 404. Items are newest-first and capped at 200; no totals.

patch.description: Partial owner-only update. Requires the write scope and a verified email. Built-in lists cannot be renamed or edited (400); missing, invisible and foreign lists return 404.

delete.description: Removes an owned, non-system list and its items in one transaction. Requires the write scope and a verified email. Built-in lists return 400; missing, invisible and foreign lists return 404.

get.description: Recipes authored by the viewer, newest first.

post.description: Requires the write scope and a verified email. A mix needs a name and 2..6 distinct catalog drinks, each with a pour volume or part count.

get.description: Accepts the numeric mix id or slug. The viewer must be the owner or allowed by the mix visibility (public, or friends for friends-only). Everything else is 404.
Accepted friends ranked by rating similarity. Personal to the token owner; there is no user directory.
Drinks loved by compatible friends that the viewer has not checked in yet. Personal and capped; no totals.
Every badge definition with the viewer's earned state and rule progress. Personal only.
The viewer's lifetime stats plus earned badges. No endpoint exposes another user's passport.

post.description: Private bookmark. The check-in must be visible to the token holder; saving your own check-in is allowed. Repeating the request is a no-op.

get.description: Your private bookmarks, newest save first. Rows that are no longer visible to you are skipped. There is no total.

next_before.description: Cursor for the next older page; empty on the last page.

post.description: Creates an owner-scoped list. Requires the write scope and a verified email. Missing, invisible and foreign lists are never distinguished from real ones.

post.summary: Add a drink to a list
post.description: Adds a drink by id or slug to an owned list, including the system wishlist. Re-adding an existing drink returns 200 with the original item; a new item returns 201. Requires the write scope and a verified email.

delete.summary: Remove a drink from a list
delete.description: Removes one drink from an owned list, including the system wishlist. Removing an absent item still returns 204. Requires the write scope and a verified email.

get.description: Loads 2-6 distinct drinks by slug in the requested order. Accepts `drinks=a,b` or repeated `drinks` parameters. This is not a catalog listing.

parameters.name: drinks
parameters.description: Two to six slugs, comma-separated or repeated.
